name: harvest-autofill
description: macOS menu-bar app that fills your Harvest timesheet from the work you already did.

scripts.qa:swift-format: cd packages/products/harvest-autofill && swiftformat --lint HarvestCore.swift HarvestSideEffects.swift HarvestApp.swift SwiftTests
scripts.qa:swift-lint: cd packages/products/harvest-autofill && DEV="$(xcode-select -p)"; case "$DEV" in *CommandLineTools*) DEV="$(ls -d /Applications/Xcode*.app/Contents/Developer 2>/dev/null | head -1)";; esac; DEVELOPER_DIR="$DEV" swiftlint lint --strict --quiet
scripts.qa:python-test: cd packages/products/harvest-autofill && uv run --python 3.12 --group dev pytest --cov
scripts.qa:web-test: cd packages/products/website && pnpm exec vitest run --coverage
scripts.qa:app-visual: cd packages/products/harvest-autofill && ./build.sh >/dev/null && uv run --python 3.12 --with pillow visual-check.py
